description: You are a regulatory affairs specialist at a pharmaceutical company. Open /home/ga/Documents/pbrer_draft.docx, which contains the raw text of a Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER) for the drug Nexovant (casirivimab/imdevimab) submitted to the FDA. The content was pasted from internal emails and is entirely unformatted plain text with no heading hierarchy, no tables, and no document structure. Format this document according to ICH E2C(R2) regulatory submission standards: apply proper heading hierarchy for all mandated sections (Executive Summary, Introduction, Worldwide Marketing Authorization Status, Actions Taken for Safety Reasons, Signal Evaluation, Benefit-Risk Analysis, etc.), convert the adverse event frequency data currently buried in prose into properly formatted summary tables, set the entire body text to Times New Roman 12pt with double line spacing, and add a document control header with report number PBRER-2024-NXV-003 and submission date. The document must look ready for regulatory submission. Save the formatted document.
